name: chrome-devtools
description: Control and inspect Chrome with the official Chrome DevTools MCP server and seven bundled debugging and automation skills.

interface.shortDescription: Browse, debug, and audit Chrome with MCP and skills
interface.longDescription: Use Chrome's official DevTools MCP server for browser automation, screenshots, network and console inspection, accessibility audits, performance traces, memory analysis, and extension testing. Includes seven skills, their references, and a helper that creates a named tab group for each task. Requires Node.js LTS, npm/npx, and Chrome 149 or newer. Uses your running Chrome profile and its existing logins. Enable remote debugging at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging and accept Chrome's Allow prompt on first browser use. MCP usage statistics and CrUX URL sharing are disabled by default.
defaultPrompt: Check the performance of my website and explain its LCP bottleneck
Audit accessibility and keyboard navigation on this page
Use the Chrome DevTools troubleshooting skill to fix my browser connection
